title: PRODUCTION SCHEDULING
description: Required for undergraduate students majoring in IE and OR. Job shop scheduling: parallel machines, machines in series; arbitrary job shops. Algorithms, complexity, and worst-case analysis. Effects of randomness: machine breakdowns, random processing time. Term project
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( IEOR E3608 ) and ( IEOR E3658 ) and IEOR E3608 AND IEOR E3658 ; Computer programming.
